description: Defines ASN.1 structures and classes for RRC NR DL-CCCH messages in 5G NR protocol, including message types and sequence handling.

classes.name: dl_ccch_msg_type_c
classes.description: Represents the choice of message type for DL-CCCH messages, including reject and setup options.

classes.name: dl_ccch_msg_s
classes.description: Represents the complete DL-CCCH message sequence containing the message type.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type (e.g., c1, msg_class_ext) for dl_ccch_msg_type_c.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Converts the message to JSON format.

methods.name: set_c1
methods.description: Sets the message type to c1.

methods.name: set_msg_class_ext
methods.description: Sets the message type to message class extension.
